responsibilities: Design and write zero-allocation MovementQueue components using flat Int32List data representations.
Implement A* and grid-based pathfinding solvers that write results directly to the MovementQueue.
Implement general-purpose Utility AI components and bidding system logic (tension/damping math).
constraints: Must strictly adhere to zero per-frame allocation rules.
The pathfinder must reuse pre-allocated internal coordinate arrays and pools to avoid GC allocations during search ticks.
All decisions, bids, and task updates must be calculated using flat float arrays and primitive types.
context: Focuses on providing autonomous navigation, decision-making bidding logic, and path solving systems within the engine.
